featured_reviews.name: Hiral Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered an acrylic One Direction lamp from this store as a gift, and it was absolutely perfect for any music fan! The design includes a Spotify scan code that links to a complete One Direction playlist — such a thoughtful touch. The lamp itself is just the right size: not too big, not too small (about 6 inches wide and 5 inches tall), and looks really cute.

What impressed me even more was the customer service. Their call centre was very responsive and answered all my queries promptly. I had mentioned during the order that it was for a special occasion, and they went the extra mile by including a One Direction-themed card in a well packed cardboard box with the product.

To top it all off, the lamp was delivered within just 2 hours of placing the order! They also have a great selection of other adorable collectibles like mugs, magnets, and more. I’ll definitely be ordering again soon.

Once again Thank you to Vatsal and team at the Peppy Store.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for such wonderful Feedback!! 🙏🙏 It really means a lot ! ❤️😊
